attachments_v2.post: name/type/size(size=int(data.get('size', FILE_SIZE_LIMIT))); type falsy or not in ATTACHMENT_MIME_TYPES -> 400 {'error': 'Invalid file type.', 'status': False}; asset_key=<workspace_id>/<uuidhex>-<name>; size_limit=min(size, FILE_SIZE_LIMIT); FileAsset.create(attributes={name,type,size:size_limit}, asset=key, size, workspace, created_by, issue, project, ISSUE_ATTACHMENT); presigned POST via S3Storage(request).generate_presigned_post(key, type, size_limit) -> 200 {'upload_data': ..., 'asset_id': str, 'attachment': row, 'asset_url': url}
